To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
four QTL associated to α-Toc, eight QTL associated to γ-Toc, four QTL associated δ-Toc and five QTL for total VE were identified by using a F6-derived F7 RIL population.
we identified four QTL associated α-Toc, eight QTL associated γ-Toc, four QTL associated δ-Toc, and five QTL related to total VE contents in soybean seeds.
four QTL associated α-Toc, eight QTL associated γ-Toc, four QTL associated δ-Toc and five QTLs associated with total VE were identified in soybean.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of loci controlling the contents of VE in soybean seed.
the identification and location of QTL associated with VE contents in soybean seeds.
the genetic basis of the high VE content trait, which will be helpful for soybean breeding.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
these QTL would have value for breeding soybeans with high VE content.
these four QTL would have a great potential value for MAS in soybean breeding for high VE content.
these QTL have the potential to be useful markers for breeding soybean with high VE content.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the QTL associated with VE contents in soybean seeds are highly environment-specific and the QTL detected in one year may be not detected in the other year.
the major QTL for α-Toc was located on LG C2, and the major QTLs for γ-Toc and total VE were located on LG C1.

a total of 21 QTL associated with four tocopherol isomers and total VE were identified, which would provide a solid foundation for further fine mapping, map-based cloning and marker assisted selection for higher VE content in soybean seeds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to identify QTL for VE contents in soybean seeds by using the F5-derived F5 recombinant inbreds lines (RILS).
the QTL for VE contents were not only detected by marker Ssatt376 on linkage Group C2 and Satt266 on linkage Group D1b, but also by other markers on linkage Group C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, D1a, D1c and D2.
the QTL for VE in soybean seed can be detected in different environments and that the QTL can have different effects on the VE content in the seed.
